title: docs(qa): 18.0 sweep round 9 — three pin over-claims narrowed, comma-range line citations re-pointed
body:
Refs #24579
Clause-②: no

Round 9 of the 18.0 release sweep's wave anchor (#24579), claim `6282463055`. One PR in two parts. These are checklist defects only: no product code, test, pin or objectui spec changes, in either repository. Each of the 23 edited items takes one `revision` bump and one `history` row (3 in part A, 20 in part B). The rows' `ref` is a placeholder in this head; a fill commit replaces exactly those strings with this PR's number.

Base: `origin/main` `39e93b9ef9` (fast-forwarded; the branch carries no merge). objectui was read only, with `git show` at the shipped pin `12dc7b47c340` and at the sweep pin `4016370af3c9`, and older objectui files were fetched as raw text at the pin each item was authored against.

## Part A — `records-forms.json`, the seat ruling and round 8's three half-claims

| item | fields | revision | spec / pin | what it asserts | choice |

The verify now says what it asserts and that this run's two-line invoice payload is read from the network trace. Tier 1 run #24598 scored `acceptance[0]` pass on it (2/2) |

The spec was never in this item's `automated.ref` (API pins only), so there is nothing to drop there. Bounded in-place fix in the same item: `knownGaps[0]`'s `createColumn ~7354-7368`, a tilde line range no gate reads, became the `sql-driver.ts#createColumn` anchor its own text already named |

Run records named in the history rows: #24598 (Tier 1), #24572 (round 1, records-forms) and #24616 (round 2, records-forms).

## Part B — the comma-range line-citation sweep

Round 7's report (`6281433885`, `out_of_scope_findings[1]`) named the spelling `file.ts,NNN` / `file.ts,NNN-MMM`. It is the residue of #13786's strip (`cd354fd5e8`): that commit removed only the first range of each colon list (`:A,B` became `,B`), and the line-citation limb reads only the colon spellings, so nothing caught what was left.

**Census, re-taken over every string of every `areas/*.json` file** (items and area-level recipes), with a rule wider than round 7's: a comma and 2–5 digits right after a word character, or an extension, a comma, a space and digits.

| reading | at BASE `39e93b9ef9` | at head `347186527d` |
|:--|--:|--:|
| matches | 46 | 6 |
| line citations among them | 42 | 2 |
| — in round 7's 20 named items | 36 (35 fields) | 0 |
| — in area-level recipes (`attachments-storage` ×3, `automation` ×1) | 4 | 0 |
| — in `access-security.platform-owner-email-anchor`, held by open PR #24667 | 2 | 2 |
| not citations (a count after a file name: `cli.dev-automigrate-policy` history[1], `integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle` acceptance[8], `platform-core.settings-hub-roundtrip` history[2], `records-forms.adhoc-filter-sort-builder` stale.partial) | 4 | 4 |
| in the excluded items | 0 | 0 |

Round 7 counted 21 items; the list it gives has 20, and all 20 hit. The wider rule also found two forms its rule missed: the share-link item's `branch,190-234` and the packaged-automation board's `(529 clone-dialog validation,516 …)`.

**How each was re-pointed.** For every citation I found the commit that authored the original colon list (`git log -S`, before `cd354fd5e8`) and read the cited lines there, then found that code at this base. An objectstack citation became a `file#symbol` anchor the shared resolver accepts; a test file is cited by its case or block title; an objectui citation names the component, function or branch in prose, read at the shipped pin `12dc7b47c340`. Where the surrounding words still described the range the strip had removed, the new citation names that code too (for example both auth-manager gates, both code literals of the clone test, both invoice arms). The history rows do not contain any path-qualified anchors or comma ranges, so a later rename never forces an edit to a dated record.

**Gate readings** (`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`): symbol anchors **918/928 at BASE → 949/959 at head**, +31 new anchor occurrences (28 resolve as `declaration`, 3 as `literal`: `#RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `#RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, `#regenerate_backup_codes`), none refused, 18 file floors held; line citations 0 survive.

PM hypotheses, measured:
1. **Holds.** `LINE_ANCHOR` needs a colon and `PATHLESS_COLON_CITATION` a colon too, so a comma-range passes today; the count rose by exactly the anchors added and none was refused. Two runs on the way caught my own history text writing a colon-digit range and a path-qualified anchor, and both were reworded before any commit.
2. **Holds, but the measured discriminator is the authoring commit, not the last revision.** Of the 40 re-pointed citations, 34 no longer pointed at their code at BASE or at the shipped pin; 5 still did (useAiSurface.ts, the clone test, the index-drift test, the unique-constraint test's line 141, the showcase apps index); and the memory-driver range never held the comment it quotes, even at the commit that authored it. Diffing each cited file between the item's last revision and BASE answers "unchanged" for 9 of 19 file pairs, including files whose cited lines had already moved before that revision, so that diff alone would have kept stale lines.
3. **Holds.** `grid-file-upload.spec.ts` stays in `attachments-storage.inline-grid-receipt-cells`' `automated.ref`, and `summary-rollup.spec.ts` stays in `records-forms.field-type-matrix`'s `source[4]` and in `master-detail-atomic-save`'s dropped-at-revision-5 note; only the three named items changed.

## Left alone, with reasons

- `access-security.platform-owner-email-anchor` `source[5]` / `source[7]`: `env.ts#PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL_ENV,200` and `admin-routes.ts#manage_platform_settings,261`, the same residue behind an anchor that #15159 added later. Open PR #24667's head `1e8338d3b669` edits this item (`steps[0]`, `revision`, `history`), so it is out of this claim, although the dispatch's excluded list does not name it. Read at the authoring commit `45397edf53`, `,200` was `resolvePlatformOwnerEmail` and `,261` the `DATASOURCE_ADMIN_CAPABILITY` declaration, which is what a later round should anchor.
- The dispatch's excluded items (`records-forms.object-hook-lifecycle`, `cli.migrate-plan-apply-json`, `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony`, `access-security.org-admin-assignment-boundary`, the seven walled-theme items) and `RUNNER.md`: none carries a comma-range citation at BASE, and none was edited. PRs #24714, #24722 and #24732 have merged since the dispatch; their items stay out of this claim.
- The four count-after-file-name matches in the census table: they are not line citations, and two sit in dated `history` rows.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/FOLLOW-UPS.md`: 11 comma-range citations. It is the sweeps' decision register, whose own header says "append, never rewrite", and it is outside the area ledger and this claim's file surface.

## Choice I settled myself: objectui citations in prose, not as `objectui:` anchors

The grammar declares a cross-repo `objectui:` form, but this corpus registers no objectui checkout (`crossRepos` is empty), so the gate would report such an anchor as skipped and never judge it. By the four axes: **business need** — a runner needs the code located, and the component and branch names do that at the pin; **long-term fit** — an anchor the gate cannot check looks verified and is not, the "declared ≠ enforced" shape; **AI-error prevention** — a later agent would read a `#symbol` as gate-checked; **no scope creep** — the cross-repo form would invite registering a checkout, a new gate surface nobody asked for. Round 7 re-pointed its objectui comma-range (`ExternalDatasourcePanel.tsx`) in prose too. Each objectui symbol named here was read at `12dc7b47c340`.

## Acceptance notes (noted, not filed)

- Residues of the same #13786 strip that carry no number, and so do not rot: parentheticals left as `(…), (…)` once their colon prefixes went, for example `automation.packaged-flow-subflow-disable-refusal` `source[1]` and `search.command-palette-navigation` `source[0]`. They point at no line; a reader loses only the position. carrier: #24579.
- `records-forms` carries prose line numbers ("line 124", "lines …") in the permission-zoo text of one item; no gate reads them. carrier: #24579.

The same three come from `origin/main` against that head alone, with none of this branch's commits, and `cli.json` auto-merges; the conflict is between #24681 and `main`.

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths; 10 paths vs merge base `39e93b9ef`): 13 families. All 13 ran on head `347186527d`, each exit captured before any pipe, all exit 0: `node scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`; `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs`; `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs --self-test`; `node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`; `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs`; `pnpm check:doc-authoring`; `pnpm check:driver-memory-census`; `pnpm check:gitlink-declared`; `pnpm check:nul-bytes`; `pnpm check:platform-checklist`; `pnpm check:refd-timer-probe`; `pnpm check:watch-hint-literal`. `--ran`: "13 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 13 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". `check:doc-formula-expressions` first answered exit 3 (its prerequisite: `@objectstack/lint` unbuilt) and exit 0 after `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c 'pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint'` ("VERDICT command-exit 0"). `check:platform-checklist` runs in no per-PR CI, so the local reading is its evidence: "OK — 16 areas, 328 items (323 active, 1 planned)", symbol anchors 949/959.

Editing discipline: every area-file edit went through round 6's span-recording textual editor (`span-edit.mjs`, md5 `25b593a1721e1baaadd973794394f622`), extended with a `replace` op that pins its prior text (exactly one occurrence) and with recipe paths outside `items`. It never re-serialises a file, and it asserts that the new document equals the old with the declared ops applied, that every other item and top-level key is value-equal, that the changed leaf paths are the declared fields plus `revision` and one new `history` row, and that the text outside the edited spans is byte-identical.

No changeset: `docs/qa/**` ships in no package (the root package is private and no `files[]` names it), so the PR carries `skip-changeset`.
